2. Sample Data for Initial Load.

ACID = 'PA1559997' and DMD_DATE = '2016-02-22' and dmd_flow_id = 'PRDEM' will be updated on the next run
ACID = 'PA3804929' and DMD_DATE = '2018-01-10' and dmd_flow_id = 'PRDEM' will be deleted from the source on the next run
